chargePerTime.label: Charge per time
chargePerTime.description: Set the parking fee charged for each hour a vehicle occupies a parking space.

latePaymentFee.label: Late Payment Fee
latePaymentFee.description: Set the maximum amount of time a vehicle can occupy a parking space. (Put 0 if this feature is not desired)

customTimeRate.label: Custom Time Rate
customTimeRate.description: Configure flexible parking rates based on custom time intervals, allowing different charges for specific durations, such as the first hour, subsequent hours, or overnight parking.

gracePeriod.label: Grace Period
gracePeriod.description: Set the additional time allowed before parking fees or penalties begin to apply. (Put 0 if this feature is not desired)

maxParking.label: Max parking duration
maxParking.description: Set the maximum amount of time a vehicle can occupy a parking space. (Put 0 if this feature is not desired)

lateNotif.label: Late Payment Notifications
lateNotif.description: Automatically notify designated staff members when a parking payment becomes overdue, allowing them to follow up and manage outstanding payments.

hardwareAlerts.label: Hardware Connection Alerts
hardwareAlerts.description: Notify administrators when connected parking hardware, such as sensors or cameras, loses its connection to the system.

deviceHealth.label: Device Health Monitoring
deviceHealth.description: Monitor the operational status of connected hardware devices and identify potential malfunctions or maintenance needs.

autoSync.label: Automatic Device Synchronization
autoSync.description: Configure how frequently connected hardware devices synchronize their data with the UPark platform to maintain up-to-date parking information.
